name: skillbridge
description: SkillBridge: tailors your resume to a job without inventing anything, then teaches and quizzes you on the skills you're missing (MERN + LLM)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
